text: One lamp still burned in the old observatory. Night gathered over the mountains beyond the arches; the wind smelled of approaching rain.

speaker: Lia
text: I kept the lantern burning. I thought you might find your way back before dawn.

speaker: Lia
text: Waiting might be easier if any of the clocks in this place still worked.
A faint sound came from the door. Lia fell quiet and listened. Behind its glass, the little flame did not move.

speaker: Lia
text: Only the wind. There is still time to watch the stars.
She drew a chair away from the window. Two cups stood warm on the table, ready for a conversation that could finally begin.
